subject: Saturday visit plan
text: The plan for Saturday is still workable, but I have made a few adjustments after checking the bus schedule and the weather. I can arrive around ten, unless that is too early. If the light is better later, ten thirty would be fine, as long as the path by the shed is clear enough for the tripod and the two boards we discussed. I will bring the folding chair, the extension cord, and the small clamp that fits the fence rail. The tape measure is in the side pocket, so we should not need another trip back to my place. One unexpectedly good outcome is that the old bench near the gate is now dry enough to use, which means we can stage the materials without leaving them on the damp grass. I had assumed we would spend the first part of the visit moving things around, but the bench seems sturdy, and the hinge on the gate has been repaired. That should save time. If the wind picks up, we can shift the session to the covered area beside the garage. I will call if I leave late, but I expect to reach the end of the lane by noon, so the rest of the afternoon will remain clear for cleanup. If you would rather not handle the cord reel, please leave it by the door and I will bring a shorter one. A reply is not necessary unless the plan changes, but if the bench is still unusable, let me know so I can pack a tarp. Otherwise, I will see you Saturday.
